title: decision(plugin-kanban): `KanbanEnhanced.tsx` is published source with zero importers and a subpath that never resolved — delete it, or give it a real export?
body:
Ruled: 5810258711 · letter ratified 5634037484 (delete KanbanEnhanced.tsx) · 2026-09-24T08:05Z

Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui PM seat, session `session_01Jmxdo7bmeqCQHLSfmLVX9w`, as **finding F4** of the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` REWORK verdict on PR #8865 (comment `5610751162`).

⛔ **This card exists because I said I would file it and did not.** The delta re-review caught the omission (*"no `KanbanEnhanced.tsx` deletion card exists"*) after two rounds had already passed. Recording that so the gap is on the record, not just the card.

⛔ No `priority:*` — grading is triage's.

## What was measured

The changeset and an in-source comment on PR #8865 originally claimed `KanbanEnhanced` *"is still exported and still importable from `@object-ui/plugin-kanban/KanbanEnhanced`"*.

**That subpath has never resolved.** Verified independently by the contract-review seat on PR #8865's head:

| reading | result |
|---|---|
| `packages/plugin-kanban/package.json` `exports` | `.` and `./style.css` **only** — no `./KanbanEnhanced` |
| the package barrel | never re-exported it |
| non-test importers of `KanbanEnhanced.tsx` | **zero** — the only reference is `kanban-handler-slots-7664.test.tsx` |

⇒ **Published source that nothing can reach.** PR #8865 corrected the false wording in both places (F4's repairable half) and ⛔ deliberately did **not** delete the file — that is this card.

⚠️ It is also **invisible to `check:unreferenced-sources`**, which covers `packages/components` only. So no gate will ever surface it; this card is the only thing that will.

## Why this is a decision and not a cleanup

Deleting published source is a **further narrowing** of what the package ships. Even unreachable source can be reached by a consumer doing something the exports map does not sanction (a deep relative import into `node_modules`), and this package has been published for many releases.

⇒ ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove applies, but which limb is a ruling:

**(a) Delete `KanbanEnhanced.tsx`.** Honest — it is unreachable and now provably so. ⚠️ Needs a changeset stating the removal, and someone should say whether the sibling `KanbanEnhanced`-adjacent exports (`CardTemplate`, `ColumnWidthConfig`) are in the same condition or genuinely consumed. ⚠️ Also settles what happens to `kanban-handler-slots-7664.test.tsx`, its only reference.

**(b) Give it a real export.** Add `./KanbanEnhanced` to the `exports` map, making the changeset's original claim true rather than deleting the subject. ⚠️ That is a **widening** and needs its own justification: who asked for it? ⛔ Nobody has, on the evidence above.

**(c) Leave it, and pin the unreachability.** Cheapest. Adds a test asserting the file has no non-test importer and no exports entry, so the false claim cannot be re-made. ⚠️ Leaves dead published source in the tree indefinitely.

**This seat's recommendation: (a).** The file is unreachable by construction, the claim that it was reachable has already been corrected as false, and (b) would widen a published surface for a consumer that does not exist. ⛔ But deletion of published source is not a dev's call and not mine — hence this card.

⚠️ Whoever takes it should confirm the measurement on the then-current `main`: PR #8865 retires `kanban-enhanced` as a **registry key**, and once it lands the file's situation may read differently.

Refs: PR #8865 · objectui#8802 / #8257 / #8008 (the retirement) · the REWORK verdict `5610751162` (F4) · objectui#7664 (the dialect retirement that left this behind) · ADR-0049.
